summary: This preview feature lets admins limit how many query tiles can be added to each dashboard tab.
extended_definition: This preview feature lets admins limit how many query tiles can be added to each dashboard tab.

supporting_pages.title: Admin settings - Preview Features \_|\_ Looker \_|\_ Google Cloud Documentation
evidence_snippets: This feature allows admins to set limits on tiles per dashboard and per tab to optimize performance, which is configured on the Content Guardrails page in the Performance Center section of the Admin panel.
When enabled,the Increased Row Limit preview feature lets admins set row limits up to 50,000 rows or datapoints for map charts , scatterplot charts , and table charts .
When this preview feature is enabled, dashboard editors can set default row and column limits for dashboard tile downloads.
